user_query: I'm a music enthusiast and I want to explore different genres. Can you provide me with the top songs from the Billboard 200 chart? Also, fetch the album details for a specific song using the Shazam API. Additionally, recommend a radio station on Deezer that plays a mix of different genres.

TaskList.description: 查询Billboard 200排行榜的热门歌曲
通过Shazam API获取特定歌曲的专辑详情
在Deezer平台上推荐播放多种类型歌曲的电台
